title: markdown-test-inputs: the adjudicated ledger only admits out-of-tree markdown reads under content/docs, so other root markdown reads by ui tests are missing from it
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxRDKprCtjpEdtiPFW

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding of the #37935 dev (os-dev report, #37935 comment 7232776944, second item); filed on seat 1's routing. Source: seat repo:objectstack#1 area `o1-F`.
Grading: area:fleet · Bug · p2 · reach: the markdown test-input ledger that `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` produces · evidence: code read on `3402071c`.
Dedupe: `markdown-test-inputs deriveCandidates` → 1 hit, #37935 itself.

## 维护者速读

- 问题：有个工具专门登记「ui 测试读了哪些 markdown 文件」，但它只认 content/docs 下的文件。ui 测试读其他位置的 markdown（例如根目录的 ADR）就不会被登记，台账看起来完整，其实漏了。
- 修法：让登记范围覆盖 ui 测试在 ui 目录外读到的所有 markdown，并加一个能证明漏登会变红的测试。
- 要你做的：无。

## Rule

The adjudicated ledger lists every markdown file a ui test reads, wherever it lives. A read the producer does not admit is either admitted or refused loudly, never dropped.

## Measured

`deriveCandidates()` in `ui/scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` accepts out-of-tree reads only under `content/docs`. The root `docs/adr` markdown read of `studioMenuPlacement.test.ts` is therefore absent from the ledger.

## Acceptance

- The producer admits out-of-`ui/` markdown reads beyond `content/docs`, or fails naming the read.
- A pin: a ui test reading a root markdown file appears in the ledger; an ablation that drops the admission reds it.

Order: independent of #37935's PR; may share its branch family. Blocked-by: none
